title: Forever Word
story:
A gardener once planted two types of plants in his garden.

One grew very fast and looked beautiful.

But it was weak.

After a strong wind, it withered quickly.

The other plant grew slowly.

It took time.

But its roots went deep into the soil.

When storms came, it remained strong.

The gardener said,

“Fast growth is not always strong growth.”

“Only what is rooted deeply will last.”

In life, many things look impressive for a moment.

Success fades.

Beauty fades.

Popularity fades.

Even human life is temporary.

But God’s Word is different.

It does not fade.

It does not fail.

It remains forever.

And those who build on it will stand forever.
life_lesson:
Everything in this world is temporary.

Only God’s Word is eternal and unchanging.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You that Your Word never fades.

Help me to build my life on what is eternal.

When I chase temporary things, remind me of what truly lasts.

Root me deeply in Your truth.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Are you focused more on temporary things or eternal truth?

What areas of your life need deeper roots in God’s Word today?

How can you live with eternity in mind?
verse:
All people are like grass,
and all their glory is like the flowers of the field.
The grass withers and the flowers fall,
but the word of the Lord endures forever.
